# Exploratory Analysis
```{r}
#| label: loading the data and summary table

regdata <- read.csv("~/GitHub/MUSA-5000-portfolio/HW1/RegressionData.csv")

regdata <- regdata %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric))

sum_table <- 
sum_table <- regdata %>%
  mutate(avg_medhval = mean(regdata$MEDHVAL)) %>%
  mutate(sd_medhval = sd(regdata$MEDHVAL))

sum_hist <- hist(sum_table$avg_medhval)

print(sum_table)
summary(sum_table)

```
